about.title: About this archive
about.lede: An unofficial archive of the competitions of the DQMJ3P Online community servers. No account is needed and nothing here requires a login.

scoring.title: Grand Prix points
scoring.body: Each ticket plays three rounds. The points of every ticket of the week are added up, exactly as the game server does; players with equal points share the rank.

cutoffs.title: Published and provisional standings
cutoffs.body: The game publishes each day the standings up to the day before. The published view shows the same; the provisional view adds the results received today. Contest days follow the Grand Prix time zone shown with each date.

gcup.title: G-Cup
gcup.body: The G-Cup changes every Monday at 00:00 UTC and a cup returns every twelve weeks. Each week is a separate edition with its own permanent link. Times are measured in frames at 30 per second.

identity.title: Players and names
identity.body: Grand Prix and G-Cup use different game accounts, so they have separate profiles. Names are shown as they were when each result was uploaded; renaming does not change old results.

coverage.title: What is missing
coverage.body: Results stored before the archive existed may lack the original name; overwritten race attempts and deleted replays cannot be recovered. Pages say so where it applies.

battles.title: Battles
battles.body: Grand Prix rounds are fought against downloaded teams, not live opponents. Direct Wi-Fi battles are not recorded by the server.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Profiles use random public identifiers: friend codes, account numbers and addresses are never shown. Followed players and settings stay in your browser.
